headline: Nvidia slump drags Nasdaq, S&P 500 lower
hook: AI hype cools as Nvidia shares tumble.
what: After a strong rally on Monday, U.S. equity indexes slipped on Tuesday. Nvidia’s price drop sparked a broader retreat in technology stocks, pulling down the Nasdaq and the S&P 500.
why: Young investors should watch AI‑related holdings for volatility and consider diversifying.

headline: Harbinger secures funding from Palmer Luckey’s Erebor Bank
hook: Electric truck maker taps a new banking partner for cash.
what: The EV truck startup Harbinger has partnered with Erebor Bank, owned by Palmer Luckey, to obtain financing. This adds a fresh source of capital for the company.
why: New funding can help the startup expand, potentially creating jobs and tech opportunities for Indian youth. Keep an eye on emerging EV ventures.

headline: Delhi tribunal orders tax probe into ₹58 lakh family cash transfer
hook: Large cash gifts between spouses may attract tax scrutiny
what: The Delhi Income Tax Appellate Tribunal told the tax department to review a ₹58.07 lakh deposit made by a woman. Authorities will check if the money came from cash her husband withdrew after selling agricultural land.
why: Young people should keep proper records for big family money moves to avoid tax issues

headline: Para-sports selection trials take place in Visakhapatnam
hook: Young athletes get a chance to represent India
what: The para-sports federation organized selection trials in Visakhapatnam. Athletes competed for spots in upcoming events.
why: These trials help identify talent for international competitions, offering opportunities for aspiring para-athletes.

headline: 13 Dead in UAE Bus‑Truck Crash, Indians Among Victims
hook: A bus with 41 passengers collided with a truck, killing 13.
what: A passenger bus carrying 41 people in the United Arab Emirates hit a truck, resulting in 13 fatalities. Indian nationals were among those killed.
why: Young travelers should double‑check transport safety when abroad and keep emergency contacts ready.

headline: Temple board insists on traditional Karthigai Deepam lighting spot
hook: They say age‑old customs trump the court’s directive.
what: The temple’s managing committee voted unanimously to keep the lamp lighting at its historic location, despite a Supreme Court order calling for a change.
why: For young people, it shows the clash between heritage practices and legal rulings, reminding them to respect tradition while staying aware of the law.

headline: Uber, Nuro test driverless Lucid SUVs in California
hook: Self‑driving cars are hitting real streets now.
what: Uber teamed up with robot‑delivery firm Nuro to run driver‑less trials of Lucid’s Gravity SUV model. The vehicles are being driven on public roads around the San Francisco Bay Area.
why: Shows how autonomous tech is moving toward everyday use, hinting at future ride‑hailing options for Indian youth. Keep an eye on similar trials that could arrive locally.

headline: GST refunds not automatically taxable, Delhi ITAT rules
hook: Your GST refund won’t be taxed just because it shows up in audit.
what: A Delhi Income Tax Appellate Tribunal decision clarified that a GST refund cannot be considered taxable income solely based on its appearance in a tax audit report. The ruling protects businesses that had previously paid GST but did not record it as an expense.
why: This means firms can claim refunds without fearing extra income‑tax liability, helping cash flow. Companies should keep proper GST records to avoid disputes.

headline: Solar and Batteries Target Power Needs of Future AI Data Centers
hook: AI farms could run on sunshine and stored energy.
what: Next‑generation AI data centers will require tens of gigawatts of electricity each year. An investor linked to Crusoe believes solar power and battery storage are the logical solution.
why: This shift could create greener tech jobs and lower energy costs, relevant for students interested in sustainability or tech careers. Keep an eye on renewable projects in the AI space.

headline: ESIC simplifies sickness, maternity payouts under new 2026 rules
hook: No more paperwork for common health benefits—money goes straight to you.
what: The Employees’ State Insurance (General) Regulations, 2026 started on November 21, replacing the 1950 rules. Under the new framework, eligible workers get sickness and maternity benefits via direct payments, without filing separate claims. Payout timelines are now clearly defined.
why: Young workers can expect faster cash support when they’re ill or pregnant, so they should verify the deadline for receiving payments to avoid missing out.

headline: Karthigai Deepam lit at Thirupparankundram despite SC ban
hook: Traditional lamp ceremony sparks police clash and court orders
what: During the Karthigai Deepam celebration, a lamp was lit at the historic Thirupparankundram site even though the Supreme Court had ordered it not to be. The High Court issued a John Doe order to stop calls for violating that order. Members of Hindu groups protested and clashed with police, while the Tamil Nadu BJP chief warned of deploying 10,000 officers.
why: The incident shows how religious customs can clash with legal rulings, reminding young people to stay aware of civic issues and respect court decisions.

headline: Bangladesh calls Hasina's return claim a bluff
hook: She announced a comeback, but officials say it's a lie.
what: Sheikh Hasina said she will return. Bangladesh officials responded by calling the statement a bluff.
why: Keeping up with nearby political news helps you stay aware of regional developments.

headline: Four nabbed in Surat UPI fraud of ₹9.02 lakh
hook: A big UPI scam in Surat leads to four arrests.
what: Police in Surat arrested four suspects accused of siphoning about ₹9.02 lakh through the UPI payment system. The alleged fraud involved unauthorized transfers using digital wallets.
why: Young users should double‑check transaction details and protect UPI PINs to avoid similar scams.

headline: IND-A faces UAE in Asia Cup Rising Stars clash
hook: Catch the next big youth cricket showdown in Doha tonight!
what: The 11th Group B match of the Asia Cup Rising Stars is set for Doha on Nov 24, 2026. India A will play the United Arab Emirates in a day‑night 50‑over game. The 12th Group B match is also scheduled at the same venue.
why: It gives young cricketers a stage to shine and fans a glimpse of future stars. Follow live updates on ESPN or Cricinfo.

headline: Ranbir Kapoor's 'Ramayana' hits ₹1,700 cr in 19 days
hook: The epic just broke new box‑office records.
what: The film crossed the ₹1,700 crore mark on its 19th day, with domestic earnings topping ₹1,000 crore and worldwide total exceeding ₹1,600 crore. It also became the top‑earning Indian movie overseas, excluding China, and outperformed 'Dhurandhar' in the US market.
why: Such earnings show the strong pull of Indian mythological cinema among young audiences; fans can watch the movie in theatres with lower ticket prices now.

headline: Supreme Court permits one‑time Karthigai Deepam lighting at Thirupparankundram
hook: The iconic lamp finally shines on the hill after a court nod.
what: The Supreme Court gave a limited, one‑time permission to light the Karthigai Deepam at its traditional spot on the Thirupparankundram hills. The lamp was lit during the festival despite earlier disputes. Authorities oversaw the event.
why: The decision shows how legal rulings can affect cultural celebrations, reminding youths to stay informed about civic processes. Follow official updates if you plan to attend.

headline: Teen Vaibhav Sooryavanshi hits 204 in 53 balls
hook: A 13‑plus Indian smashed a List A double‑century record.
what: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored 204 runs from 53 deliveries, including 28 sixes, becoming the fastest player to reach both 100 and 200 in List A cricket. The innings came against the United Arab Emirates.
why: The feat highlights emerging talent for Indian cricket and inspires young players to aim high.

headline: Uttarakhand to give 5.23 lakh women ₹20,000 each
hook: First ₹10,000 hits wallets this December
what: Uttarakhand will distribute ₹20,000 to each of 5.23 lakh women under the Baini‑Bhuli Yojana. The scheme is funded with ₹523 crore. The initial ₹10,000 will be credited directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts in December.
why: The cash boost aims to strengthen financial security for women, influencing families and local economies. Eligible women should verify their bank details to receive the payment.

headline: Matangi Rubber and Monomark Engineering set for December IPOs
hook: Two new stock listings could open fresh investment chances for young savers.
what: Matangi Rubber Ltd announced its initial public offering slated for December, with price band and issue size to be disclosed. Monomark Engineering plans a fresh issue of ₹120 crore, targeting FY26 revenue of about ₹562 crore. The promoters of Monomark currently hold over 91% of the shares before the issue.
why: These listings give Gen Z investors new options to start building a portfolio, but they should research the companies and risks before buying shares.

headline: GTA VI leak culprit gets 7-year sentence, released same day
hook: A gamer’s cheat turned into a courtroom drama.
what: A hacker who stole and shared about 90 unreleased Grand Theft Auto VI videos was sentenced to seven years in prison. He was released on licence later that day with a warning not to repeat the offence.
why: Shows that sharing pirated game content can lead to serious legal trouble, so avoid distributing leaked media.

headline: Nvidia boss acknowledges extra affairs before comeback
hook: A surprise confession from the tech leader before his return
what: In a meeting held prior to his reinstatement, Jensen Huang said he had more than the two affairs already reported. The admission was noted by the Wall Street Journal.
why: Personal conduct of a high‑profile CEO can shape public perception of the company, so young professionals should stay informed about leadership behavior.

headline: Karthigai Deepam lit atop Ucchi Pillayar Temple in Madurai
hook: The festival lamp shines from a new spot this year.
what: In Thiruparankundram, Madurai, the Karthigai Deepam was illuminated on the Ucchi Pillayar Temple. Traditionally, it is lit on the deepathoon stone pillar, but this time the temple roof hosted the flame.
why: It marks a shift in ritual practice at a historic site, reminding young locals of their cultural heritage.

headline: Dipke says CJP stays out, urges youth‑focused UP polls
hook: A top judge wants the Uttar Pradesh vote to be about youth, not caste.
what: Abhijeet Dipke said the CJP will not get involved in the upcoming Uttar Pradesh elections. He also expressed hope that the campaign centers on young voters rather than caste or religion.
why: When elections focus on youth issues, policies on education, jobs and digital life can better reflect their needs. Staying aware helps young Indians engage responsibly.

headline: Supreme Court checks bank loan steps before EMI pressure
hook: Your unfinished flat won’t trigger forced EMIs without proper checks.
what: The apex court instructed lower courts to confirm whether banks followed construction‑linked disbursement rules before pursuing recovery from buyers stuck with incomplete apartments. This offers temporary relief from aggressive EMI collection.
why: Young homebuyers can pause repayment actions until banks’ compliance is verified, reducing financial strain. Keep loan documents handy and seek legal advice if you receive a recovery notice.

headline: Bank of India rolls out 500‑day FD with 7.65% for super seniors
hook: A new fixed‑deposit scheme could boost returns for older savers.
what: Bank of India introduced a 500‑day fixed‑deposit called Akshay FD. It offers up to 7.65% interest for super senior citizens on non‑callable deposits exceeding ₹1 crore. Rates for regular and senior citizens are also listed.
why: Understanding these rates helps families plan savings for elders and gives a benchmark for other deposit options. Young investors can compare and decide if such long‑term deposits fit their financial plans.

headline: South Africa crush Bangladesh for 91 in 2nd Test
hook: Proteas dominate with bowling, leaving Bangladesh under 100.
what: South Africa posted 274/4 while Bangladesh were dismissed for 91. Ryan Rickelton made 9 runs and Tony de Zorzi added 28. Nortje spoke about the key to the team's success.
why: The result puts South Africa in a strong position in the series, and fans can look forward to the next matches.

headline: GalaxEye taps Bellatrix for propulsion on 30 new satellites
hook: India's space startups team up for a big satellite push
what: Bengaluru‑based GalaxEye signed a multi‑year deal with Bellatrix Aerospace. The agreement covers propulsion systems for GalaxEye’s upcoming 30 Drishti satellites.
why: The partnership could boost India's satellite capabilities and create tech jobs. Keep an eye on emerging space opportunities.

headline: SC permits lamp lighting at Thirupparankundram; BJP chief arrested
hook: A holy flame sparks a legal clash and a high‑profile arrest.
what: The Supreme Court issued an interim order allowing a lamp to be lit on the disputed 'deepathoon' at Thirupparankundram during the Karthigai Deepam festival. Security was tightened around the hillock, and the Tamil Nadu BJP chief was taken into custody.
why: The decision highlights tensions between religious traditions and legal rulings, and the arrest underscores political scrutiny during festivals. Teens should stay informed about civic developments and follow official guidelines if attending the event.

headline: Sonia Gandhi warns of power’s tempting pull
hook: She says holding power can create its own excuses.
what: In a recent interview, Sonia Gandhi reflected on her 2004 decision not to become prime minister. She called it a lesson that gaining power may lead to justifying its retention.
why: Seeing this perspective helps young voters understand how leaders view authority and the need for accountability.

headline: West Bengal rolls out monthly cash for unemployed youth
hook: Get up to ₹2,000 a month if you’re 21‑45 and job‑less
what: The West Bengal government introduced the Bhorsha Karmasuchi scheme. Eligible residents aged 21 to 45 will receive a monthly allowance of either ₹1,500 or ₹2,000, based on their qualifications.
why: It provides financial relief for young people looking for work and encourages them to check eligibility. Apply through the official portal to claim the benefit.

headline: JioStar plans to lay off 150 staff to cut costs
hook: Big tech trims its media team – 150 jobs on the line.
what: Jio’s media division JioStar is set to dismiss around 150 employees. The move is aimed at reducing operating expenses.
why: The cut shows how even fast‑growing firms tighten budgets, which could affect internship and entry‑level opportunities in media. Keep an eye on job boards for other openings.

headline: Nvidia’s 31% Jump May Lift Mutual Fund NAVs
hook: A sudden surge could bump up your fund’s value.
what: Nvidia’s shares climbed 31% after CEO Jensen Huang returned. Indian mutual funds that own the chipmaker may see their net asset values rise, depending on their holdings. Experts warn against blindly chasing the rally.
why: Young investors should balance the possible gain with the stock’s volatility before adding more exposure. Knowing a fund’s exposure helps avoid unexpected risk.

headline: Priyanka Gandhi says she slapped boy who called Sanjay a thief
hook: A family story reveals a school‑yard showdown over politics
what: Priyanka Gandhi recalled hitting a classmate after he called her uncle Sanjay Gandhi a 'chor' (thief) during school days following the Emergency. She shared the memory while talking with her mother Sonia and brother Rahul.
why: It shows how political legacies can affect personal interactions, reminding youths to think before using harsh words.

headline: Bomb threat email sent against Diljit Dosanjh’s Bengaluru show
hook: A scary email warned of a bomb at Diljit’s concert and a nearby metro.
what: An email threatened an IED blast at Diljit Dosanjh’s concert in Bengaluru and at Madavara Metro Station. The North Cybercrime Police filed an FIR after receiving the threat, which ended with the slogan “Khalistan Zindabad”.
why: Such threats raise safety concerns for large public events, so attendees should stay alert and follow official security instructions.

headline: IMD warns heavy rain in South, fog in North
hook: Rainy days and foggy mornings ahead—plan your commute.
what: The Indian Meteorological Department has issued a heavy‑rain alert for the southern states and warned of dense fog in northern regions. Residents are advised to stay updated on weather updates.
why: Rain and fog can affect travel and outdoor plans, so check alerts before heading out.

headline: EPFO proposes direct PF deposits via UAN
hook: Add to your retirement fund without your boss.
what: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation has suggested a rule change that would let members put voluntary contributions straight into their UAN‑linked PF accounts, bypassing the employer. The proposal also mentions allowing small third‑party contributions, such as tips, which could help gig workers.
why: This could give freelancers and young employees more control over their savings and make it easier to boost their retirement corpus. Keep an eye on the final rules and consider using the option once it’s approved.

headline: BJP and SAD reunite for Punjab elections
hook: The oldest BJP ally is back in the NDA for Punjab polls.
what: On Guru Purab, BJP leader Amit Shah announced that Shiromani Akali Dal has rejoined the National Democratic Alliance. The two parties also disclosed a seat‑sharing arrangement for the upcoming Punjab Assembly election.
why: The alliance could shape policies on education and jobs that affect young Indians. Stay updated on the candidates and their promises.

headline: BJP and Akali Dal team up for Punjab elections
hook: Two major parties reunite after years apart to contest Punjab votes
what: The Bharatiya Janata Party and Shiromani Akali Dal announced they will contest the upcoming Punjab state election together. This marks a reunion after a split six years ago.
why: Their alliance could reshape the state's political landscape, influencing policies that affect education, jobs, and local development. Young voters should watch the campaign to see how the partnership impacts issues that matter to them.

headline: Motorola rolls out Edge 70 Neo in India
hook: A new premium phone with a massive battery hits the market.
what: Motorola introduced the Edge 70 Neo for the Indian premium segment. The device comes with a 7,000 mAh battery, a 144 Hz screen and AI‑driven photography features.
why: Young users get a phone that can last longer and capture better photos, useful for gaming and social media. Check availability before it sells out.

headline: Tharoor urges swift choice for Kerala Congress chief, rejects faction tags
hook: The MP says he's not part of any Kerala Congress cliques.
what: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor said he is neither 'Congress I' nor 'Congress A', distancing himself from Kerala's internal factions. He asked the party's top leadership to promptly decide on a new Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee chief.
why: The appointment will influence the party's direction in Kerala and impact policies that matter to young voters. Keep an eye on how the leadership race unfolds.
